events.description: A female character in a school uniform executes a high kick that strikes an opponent wearing a yellow outfit, sending them airborne and initiating a violent impact with a table.

The opponent in the yellow outfit lies incapacitated on the floor, covered in blood, while the attacker stands over them; subsequent frames show the victim gasping and bleeding heavily, indicating continued vulnerability and lack of resistance.

Two individuals engage in a choreographed martial arts fight in a restaurant interior: one in an orange jumpsuit (The Bride) and one in a school uniform (Gogo Yubari). The sequence includes weapon use (chain whip, nunchaku), acrobatic maneuvers, and dynamic combat stances, culminating in the orange-clad fighter being thrown to the floor.

Two individuals engage in a choreographed martial arts fight inside a restaurant: one in an orange jumpsuit (The Bride) and another in dark clothing (O-Ren Ishii). The sequence includes acrobatic kicks, weapon use (a sword), dodging, and close-quarters combat across multiple frames.

A female combatant in a school uniform engages in a violent fight using a spiked ball-and-chain weapon against an opponent in a yellow jumpsuit; the sequence shows weapon swing, impact, aerial takedown, and ground combat with visible debris and destruction.

After being knocked down, the opponent in yellow is on the ground while the school-uniformed fighter continues to strike or压制 them, indicating attack on a helpless victim during the final phase of the fight.

Two individuals engage in intense hand-to-hand combat inside a restaurant: one in a yellow jumpsuit (Beatrix Kiddo) attacks another in a school uniform (Gogo Yubari), involving chair throws, grappling, and weapon use (chain and baton).

After being overpowered, the victim in the school uniform is subdued and struck repeatedly while on the ground; the attacker in yellow delivers finishing blows, including a chain-wrapped strike and a final blow that results in visible bloodstain on the attacker's clothing.

A brief but violent continuation of combat as the attacker in yellow executes a high-speed aerial maneuver (leap/flip) across the room, colliding with furniture, indicating ongoing aggressive engagement.

A violent physical confrontation occurs where a woman in a yellow jacket is struck with a chained weapon (a wooden block or baton) by an opponent, resulting in her being thrown backward across the room.

The victim lies incapacitated on the floor while the attacker continues to strike her with a spinning bladed weapon (a spiked ball with rotating saw blades), indicating a one-sided assault on a helpless person.
The attacker prepares and deploys a lethal chained bladed weapon (spiked ball with circular saw blades), shown in close-up as it spins, implying imminent or ongoing combat action.
A person in a dark uniform violently swings a bladed weapon (a chained, spiked ball with rotating saw blades) downward toward a prone victim on the floor.

A woman in an orange top lies on the floor covered in blood (f3–f6), then is shown reacting to being struck: she sits up screaming (f11), and displays a deep, bloody wound on her shoulder/neck area (f14–f15), indicating she is a helpless victim of a violent attack.

A woman in an orange outfit is engaged in a physical combat sequence with another person, using a chain as a weapon; the opponent (in a plaid skirt and dark jacket) is actively defending and counter-attacking.

A person with dark hair is actively choking another person (blonde, wearing orange) using a metal chain wrapped around their neck; the victim shows signs of distress and struggle while the attacker maintains control.
